title: Wordfence Review
description: A documented profile of Wordfence’s WordPress firewall, malware scanning, and login-security tooling.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Wordfence WordPress plugin profile from KreativWP.
highlights: Wordfence Free includes an endpoint firewall, scanner, login security, alerts, and centralized management
Free threat rules and malware signatures are delayed compared with premium
The documentation covers firewall, scan, login-security, and performance-tuning workflows
bestFor: Most WordPress sites that need a documented, layered security baseline.
researchScope: This profile reviews Wordfence’s official free-tier and documentation materials. It is not an independent security audit.
caveats: Security plugins need configuration and maintenance. Review resource use, false positives, and the free-tier update delay against the site’s risk level.
